phases.786,330: The point falls on the gridded О-1 parcel west of the river bank.
phases.805,26;470,336: A stream and nearby Р-4 print support the code, but both published Р-4 phase swatches have indistinguishable solid green fills.

interpretation.education_diagonal: Two diagonally hatched О-1 areas are individually labelled and separated by a fine white line. The requested ring follows the northern area containing the seed. For a same-use footprint the union includes the southern area.
interpretation.outline_method: Visually traced vertices on enlarged, coordinate-labelled source windows, informed by preliminary color contours. Interior line in the diagonal education area was inspected directly.

city_check_design: Twelve geographically distributed windows withheld at zoom 17. Centres were selected near palette-matching pixels. Each window has one additional outside-class control. Null centre references mean the image did not establish a code. This is a targeted sample.
